seo.title: Porogaramu Zacu — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Isôoko ifite porogaramu eshanu: Guteza imbere Abakobwa (MWU), Urubyiruko (IZI), Siporo, Ikoranabuhanga, na Tûuza Mubyeyi.

womenEmpowerment.title: Guteza Imbere Abakobwa
womenEmpowerment.subtitle: Mutima W'urugo (MWU)
womenEmpowerment.desc: Guha ubushobozi abakobwa bakene kugira ngo bazane impinduka mu mibereho yabo.
womenEmpowerment.intro: Tuwizera ko kuzamuka kw'umukoresha ari ukuzamuka kw'abaturage. Porogaramu ya MWU igamije guha ubushobozi abakobwa bakene mu baturage binyuze mu bushobozi bw'akazi, amahugurwa n'inkunga y'ubucuruzi.
offerings: Amatsinda yo kuzigama no kubona inguzanyo

youthEmpowerment.title: Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko
youthEmpowerment.subtitle: Imbaraga z'Isôoko (IZI)
youthEmpowerment.desc: Guteza imbere ubuyobozi n'ubumenyi bw'urubyiruko mu karere ka Masoro.
youthEmpowerment.intro: Akarere ka Masoro gakoresha ubucukuzi bw'amabuye y'agaciro. Urubyiruko ruhura n'ibibazo by'uburezi, ubuzima bwo mu mutwe, n'akazi. Porogaramu ya IZI ikemura ibi bibazo binyuze mu buryo bw'ubufatanye.

sportsWellness.title: Siporo n'Ubuziranutse
sportsWellness.subtitle: Ubuzima bw'umubiri n'ubwo mu mutwe
sportsWellness.desc: Ahantu ho gukora siporo no guteza imbere ubuzima bwo mu mutwe mu baturage.
sportsWellness.intro: Isôoko Community Center ni ahantu ho gukora siporo, gukina, no guteza imbere ubuzima bwo mu mutwe. Abaturage bahabwa ibikorwa byinshi bya siporo n'ubuziranutse bigamije gukomeza imbaraga no gutera imbere ubuzima bwiza.
offerings: Uburezi n'ubufasha ku buzima bwo mu mutwe

digitalLiteracy.title: Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi
digitalLiteracy.subtitle: Ubumenyi bw'ikoranabuhanga
digitalLiteracy.intro: Isôoko Community Center itanga amahugurwa y'ikoranabuhanga n'uburezi bwo gusoma kugira ngo abaturage babone ubumenyi bufite agaciro ku buzima bwabo.

tuuzaMubyeyi.title: Tûuza Mubyeyi
tuuzaMubyeyi.subtitle: Kurera Abana mu Gihe ababyeyi bategura Ubuzima bwabo
tuuzaMubyeyi.desc: Kurera abana mu gihe ababyeyi bategura ubuzima bwabo.
tuuzaMubyeyi.intro: Porogaramu ya Tûuza Mubyeyi ishyigikira abanyamuryango b'abana bakene mu gihe bahugurwa kugira ngo bashobore kwiteza imbere. Abana bahabwa ibikorwa by'uburezi n'iterambere mu ahantu hateganyijwe kandi hazoroshye.
